notes: All numbers verified from game.js class NPC (constructor + update()). Movement in the original is a direct straight line toward the player with no pathfinding — the Unity EnemyAI.cs uses a real NavMeshAgent instead, a deliberate improvement, not a literal port.
scientist has a decorative gun mesh in the original but no ranged attack logic — melee-only like the others, just with a longer attackRange (12) standing in for it. Not changed here.
Loot is granted directly on death (game.js NPC.die()), not via an E-loot interaction.
